title: Faded and washed out
text: Faded and washed out. Very disappointed.  The colors are faded.  Not anything like advertised. A Kandinsky is anything but faded.  What a waste of money. Plus and inch and a half of the artwork all around is stapled out of sight to the frame.  Jeesh.
